ios.desc: ColorHunt is the go-to option for super fun scavenger hunts! It takes all the fun of scavenger hunts, and gets rid of all the tedious, and hard to manage parts. Playing is very simple, anyone can start a game, choose how many colors need to be found, how long the game will last, and then all your friends can join. Instead of finding objects like a traditional scavenger hunt, you must find colors. Using your camera, your goal is to find the best match to the color displayed on the screen, you then receive points based on how close your color is to the one that everybody is trying to find.

quotes.title: ColorHunt, a scavenger hunt where you find colors instead of things
